abstract: Portable ADHD-friendly communication and task-support skill that reduces activation and working-state friction through answer-first orientation, honest prioritization, executable steps, interruption re-entry, user-controlled depth, consent-based reminders, and non-clinical safety boundaries.

attribution.title: i-have-adhd
attribution.creator: Ayoub Ghriss
attribution.adaptation: Substantial adaptation of the action-first, low-friction output concept. This skill adds explicit portable invocation, user-controlled depth, evidence-aware estimates, re-entry state, safety boundaries, and behavioral evals; it does not use the upstream logo or branding.
